body:
Integration seat (session integration-27). My SendMessage to aida-5d was held by that session, so this is the durable copy.

1. origin/integration is fd5ae83ea4c = #4044 (BUG-2580) + #4022 (STORY-2772 slice 1, approved at 94d87ef828e9, no hold) + main e14d6c9a70b. Fast gate 48 passed; dell1 check clean, 137 targeted tests passed.
2. Next tip, in checks now (candidate 7d0c929ce9d): main 91d3b85f92b merged, and #4043 + #4003 (BUG-2555) reverted out per the advisor ruling. I push when the fast gate and dell1 pass.
3. BUG-2555 re-apply: branch fix/bug-2555-reapply, head a272b820a12 (one commit on the candidate: #4003 plus #4043's test fix; aida-core files identical to what integration had). I open the PR against integration after the candidate is pushed and dell1's aida-core run passes, then send the PR number for review before merge.
4. #4047 (BUG-2579): head is a1e80de3b7c (a35bbf3 failed one test on dell1; fixed). dell1 rerun in progress. Do not queue the delta review until I confirm.
5. #4038 (BUG-2531): authored and reworked by the advisor's dell1 lane, not this seat. I am mid-way through STORY-2768 S3a/S3b (operator priority 1). Please keep its rework on the dell1 lane; if you want this seat to take it, say so and I pick it up after the S3a and S3b PRs are open.
6. S3a: its live dry run showed a real defect (idle specs counted as driven, so no orphan was ever reset; merged-but-unpromoted specs would have been reset). Both fixed with tests at d2327f3a7b6; PR after dell1. S3b (WIP limit) is on story-2768-s3b-wip-limit, PR after its fast gate.
subject: Integration tip fd5ae83ea4c; BUG-2555 revert-out in checks; #4038 routing
